display.purpose: The headline on the landing page, capped at 14ch, the join code on the Group tab, and the winner's name in "Who goes first?".

headline.purpose: Page titles and game names on game pages.

title.purpose: Section headings; the group name in the top bar uses this size from 900px and 18px (the lead size) below.

title-small.purpose: Sub-section headings; the same 18px at body weight is the lead size for intros and pick results.

box-title.purpose: Titles printed on box fronts, clamped to four lines.

spine-title.purpose: Titles along spines, one line with ellipsis.

label.purpose: Form labels, hints at 400, small buttons, list facts.

caption.purpose: The players-and-time line under each cube and tags. Bottom tab labels are 12px at 650.

shadows.name: stand
shadows.purpose: Every box standing in a cube, its shadow falling down and to the right from the one light at the upper left.

shadows.name: stand-lift
shadows.purpose: A cube's box when hovered or focused, with a 3px rise; the cubby's light, so it falls the same way as Stand.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: Off the shelf: the picker's pulled boxes and fillers, a game page's hero box, rolled dice, the leaderboard's podium blocks.

shadows.name: box-hairline
shadows.purpose: The printed edge of every box front and spine.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Shared curve for lifts, slides, the picker pull, the modal rise and the dice tumble.

motion.name: control
motion.purpose: Button colour and press transitions; pressed buttons drop 1px.

motion.name: cube-lift
motion.purpose: A cube's box rises 3px and takes the shelf lift on hover or focus.

motion.name: fold
motion.purpose: A chevron turning over as Manage or a folding settings row opens.

motion.name: spine-slide
motion.purpose: Spine slides right on hover or focus.

motion.name: picker-pull
motion.value: 0.55s, translateY(28px) scale(0.96) to rest, 70ms stagger, tilts -2.5deg / 1.75deg / -1.25deg; hover straightens and lifts 4px over 0.25s
motion.purpose: The one authored motion: three boxes pulled off the shelf. Fillers take the same rise and stagger but stay straight and lift 3px on hover. No animation and no tilt under reduced motion.

motion.name: modal-rise
motion.purpose: A modal or bottom sheet opening. Still under reduced motion.

motion.name: reel-spin
motion.value: 2.3s, cubic-bezier(0.12, 0.6, 0.22, 1) to 86% with a 0.22-row overshoot, then ease-in-out back
motion.purpose: Who goes first: names roll up a 64px-row reel and settle on the pick. Under reduced motion the name shows without the roll.

motion.name: dice-tumble
motion.purpose: A rerolled die tumbles in. The coin face flips in over 0.35s (rotateX 90deg). Both still under reduced motion.

motion.name: skeleton-sweep
motion.value: 1.6s ease-in-out infinite, 90 to 120ms stagger between neighbours
motion.purpose: A band of light crossing shelf-gap placeholders while content loads; still under reduced motion.

motion.name: search-look
motion.purpose: The label-strip magnifier looks around while a search runs; still under reduced motion.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Global rule under prefers-reduced-motion; looping animations stop rather than flicker.

components.name: Primary Button

components.name: Label Strip
components.description: The dark shelf label holding search and filter chips; marigold marks active filters.
components.css: .ds-strip { font-family: 'Archivo Variable', 'Archivo', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; background: var(--label, #2b2a28); color: var(--label-ink, #f4f4f2); border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; } .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 12px; background: var(--label-field, #3a3835); border-radius: 8px; color: var(--label-ink-2, #c9c4bb); } .ds-search:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--mark, #e9b44c); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-search input { font: inherit; flex: 1; min-width: 0; min-height: 44px; border: 0; background: none; color: var(--label-ink, #f4f4f2); outline: none; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: var(--label-ink-2, #c9c4bb); } .ds-controls { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; } .ds-chip { font: inherit; min-height: 38px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1.5px solid var(--label-line, #5a5650); background: transparent; color: var(--label-ink, #f4f4f2); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 650; padding: 0 12px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip[aria-pressed='true'] { background: var(--mark, #e9b44c); border-color: var(--mark, #e9b44c); color: var(--mark-ink, #2b2a28); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--mark, #e9b44c); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tab Bar
components.description: Group tabs in the top bar from 900px; the whole current tab fills marigold, others take shelf gap on hover. Between 900 and 1099px the tab icons drop out and padding tightens to 8px.

components.name: Bottom Tab Bar
components.description: Below 900px the group tabs are a fixed bar on laminate: 52px targets, 12px labels, safe-area padding; the current tab's icon sits in a marigold pill.
components.html: ShelfPlay tonightGroup
components.css: .ds-bottom { font-family: 'Archivo Variable', 'Archivo', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; display: flex; justify-content: space-around; background: var(--laminate, #f4f4f2); border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, #d3cfc7); padding: 6px 4px calc(6px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); max-width: 24rem; } .ds-bottom a { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 3px; padding: 6px 2px; min-height: 52px; border-radius: 8px; color: var(--ink-2, #57534d); text-decoration: none; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 650; } .ds-bottom a[aria-current='page'] { color: var(--ink, #2b2a28); } .ds-bottom a[aria-current='page'] svg { color: var(--mark-ink, #2b2a28); background: var(--mark, #e9b44c); border-radius: 6px; padding: 2px 10px; box-sizing: content-box; } .ds-bottom a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #2b2a28); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Group Bar Tools
components.description: Three 44px icon tools in the group bar: Crown (Who goes first?) and Dice 5 open modals; Trophy links to the plays page and fills marigold while you are on it. 40px wide between 900 and 1099px.
components.css: .ds-tools { display: flex; gap: 2px; } .ds-tool { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: none; color: var(--ink-2, #57534d); cursor: pointer; } .ds-tool:hover { background: var(--gap, #e2dfd8); color: var(--ink, #2b2a28); } .ds-tool[aria-current='page'] { background: var(--mark, #e9b44c); color: var(--mark-ink, #2b2a28); } .ds-tool:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #2b2a28); outline-offset: 2px; }

On hover or focus the box rises 3px with the shelf lift. A flag pill sits 6px above the box's base.

components.css: .ds-list { font-family: 'Archivo Variable', 'Archivo', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; padding: 8px; background: var(--gap, #e2dfd8); border-radius: 6px; max-width: 36rem; } .ds-spine { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto auto; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 46px; padding-left: 12px; background: var(--sb); color: var(--si); text-decoration: none; border-radius: 2px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.08); transition: transform 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-spine:hover, .ds-spine:focus-visible { transform: translateX(4px); } .ds-spine:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #2b2a28); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-st { font-weight: 800; font-stretch: 80%; font-size: 1.0625rem; line-height: 1.1; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-sf { font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-end { align-self: stretch; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; width: 12px; } .ds-end > span { flex: 1; }

components.css: .ds-backdrop { font-family: 'Archivo Variable', 'Archivo', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; display: flex; align-items: flex-end; min-height: 260px; background: rgb(20 18 16 / 0.5); } .ds-sheet { width: 100%; background: var(--cube, #fbfbfa); color: var(--ink, #2b2a28); border: 1px solid var(--rule, #d3cfc7); border-bottom: 0; border-radius: 10px 10px 0 0; animation: ds-rise 0.28s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-sheet-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 12px 8px 24px; } .ds-sheet-head h2 { flex: 1; margin: 0; font-size: 1.375rem; font-weight: 780; font-stretch: 88%; line-height: 1.15; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-close { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: none; color: var(--ink-2, #57534d); cursor: pointer; } .ds-close:hover { background: var(--gap, #e2dfd8); color: var(--ink, #2b2a28); } .ds-close:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #2b2a28); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-sheet-body { padding: 8px 24px 24px; } .ds-sheet-body p { margin: 0; } @keyframes ds-rise { from { transform: translateY(24px); opacity: 0; } } @media (min-width: 760px) { .ds-backdrop { align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-sheet { width: min(30rem, 100% - 32px); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #d3cfc7); border-radius: 10px; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-sheet { animation: none; } }

components.css: .ds-start { font-family: 'Archivo Variable', 'Archivo', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; display: grid; gap: 16px; max-width: 26rem; color: var(--ink, #2b2a28); } .ds-well { padding: 12px 24px 16px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--laminate, #f4f4f2); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--rule, #d3cfc7); } .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; height: 72px; } .ds-cube { width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 8px; flex: none; } .ds-who { font-size: clamp(2rem, 6vw, 3.25rem); font-weight: 800; font-stretch: 82%; line-height: 1.1; } .ds-goes { margin: -14px 0 0; padding-left: 72px; color: var(--ink-2, #57534d); font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 650; } .ds-btn { justify-self: start; min-height: 52px; padding: 0 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--ink, #2b2a28); color: var(--laminate, #f4f4f2); font: inherit; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 650; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #2b2a28); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-here { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding-top: 16px; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, #d3cfc7); } .ds-here p { margin: 0; } .ds-muted { color: var(--ink-2, #57534d); } .ds-link { border: 0; background: none; padding: 0; font: inherit; font-weight: 650; color: inherit; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 0.2em; cursor: pointer; min-height: 44px; }

narrative.overview:
The catalog is drawn as the group's shared cube-storage shelf. Each game is a box standing in its own cube, a little taller than wide; the cubes sit in a grid separated by grey shelf gaps; the front edge of every cube is painted in the player colours of the people who own the game. Filters live on a dark shelf label above the grid. The ground is pale laminate, the ink is near-black, and almost everything else is low-chroma cardboard, so the owner edges are the only saturated colour on the shelf.

Density follows the use: three cubes across on a phone at the table, five to seven on a desktop at home, and a denser Spines view (boxes lying on their sides) for scanning long collections. The type is one family, Archivo, used heavy and semi-condensed for anything printed on a box and at normal width for interface text. Dark mode is the same shelf in black-brown laminate, with the same roles swapped value for value.

The world refuses the category default for game catalogs: a dark app with a grid of box-art cards and a filter sidebar. Box art from BoardGameGeek appears inside the cube when a game has it, hotlinked, never copied, standing at its own shape; games without art get a printed box front so a hand-entered shelf still looks like a shelf.
keyCharacteristics: Square cubes on a shelf-gap grid, each closed by a 6px owner-colour edge.
Pale laminate ground, near-black ink, one dark label strip per screen for filters and search.
Player colours, each member's from the day they join, are the only saturated colour; marigold marks what is chosen.
Printed box fronts in cardboard tones with a lid seam and a heavy condensed title.
Archivo alone, steered by weight (400 to 800) and width (78% to 100%).

Each cube is a compartment drawn in perspective and lit from the upper left: its box stands on the floor at the cover's own shape and casts a short shadow down and to the right, and the name and caption sit on the floor in front of it. Touched, the box lifts. A game's own page shows its box slightly tilted, and the things that stand for objects on the table (dice, podium blocks) carry the lift.

rules.name: The Marigold Means Chosen Rule
rules.body: Marigold appears only on something the person has turned on: an active filter, the current tab, a selected person, selected text, a focused field in the label strip. It never decorates, never marks ownership, and never fills a button. One exception, Carlo's pick: the Wanted tab's "Most wanted" pill, which marks a fact, with its own small shadow.

rules.name: The Owner Edge Rule
rules.body: Player colours are the only saturated colour on the shelf, and they always mean a person. Assign them when someone joins (D69), never by preference or by game, and never add a player colour that shares a hue with marigold.

rules.name: The Cardboard Print Rule
rules.body: A box front without art is a low-chroma cardboard print outside the player hues, light in most cases, dark in no more than about a quarter, and every print-and-ink pair is at least 4.5:1.

rules.name: The Printed Title Rule
rules.body: Anything that stands for a physical box (box fronts, spines, the hero box) sets its title at 800 and 78 to 80% width. Interface headings stay at 88% width and 780 or lighter, so the printed voice is reserved for the boxes.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Archivo carries every role. Hierarchy comes from weight and the width axis; no second family, no letter-spaced uppercase labels. Codes are the one tracked-out uppercase setting (the join code and sign-in codes), because they're read aloud.

rules.name: The Shelf Gap Rule
rules.body: Cubes are separated by the shelf-gap colour showing between them, not by borders or shadows. A new grid of games sits on the same gap ground.

rules.name: The Thumb Reach Rule
rules.body: Below 900px the group tabs are a fixed bottom bar with 52px targets and safe-area padding; below 760px the filter row scrolls sideways in one line rather than wrapping. Tap targets are 44px for buttons and search, 38px for filter chips, 40px for person toggles. On a touch screen (`pointer: coarse`) nothing drawn as a button is under 44px: `--tap` (app.css) is 44px there and 0 under a mouse, and small buttons, chips, segments, person toggles, icon buttons, selects and the cube mark's link take `max(their size, var(--tap))`. Text links and link buttons keep their line height (24px, inside WCAG's minimum).

rules.name: The Lift On Touch Rule
rules.body: Only a thing that stands for an object gets a shadow: a box standing in its cube, a box off its shelf (touched, pulled, or shown on its own page), a rolled die, a podium block. Panels, wells, buttons and chips stay flat.

dos: **Do** put every grid of games on the shelf-gap ground with 6px gaps (8px from 760px) and close each cube with the owner edge.
**Do** take player colours from `playerColor()` by the member's stored `colorIndex` and box prints from `boxColor()` by name; both live in `src/lib/catalog/colors.ts`.
**Do** keep marigold for state: active filters, the current tab, selected people, text selection and focused label-strip fields.
**Do** set box and spine titles at 800 and 78 to 80% width, and interface headings at 780 and 88%.
**Do** hotlink BGG box art and fall back to the printed front when it is missing or fails to load.

**Do** render the footer on every page, including new routes outside the root layout. It carries the BGG credit whenever the instance shows BGG data; an instance that has never had BGG on shows only Privacy, Source, the version and the theme select.
**Do** give any new motion a reduced-motion state with no animation. A static tilt (the game page's box, the landing's boxes) may stay.

**Do** put `{@attach announce}` on a message that appears after an action ("Saved.", "Link added."), so a screen reader hears it, and give each page its own `<title>`. An error that appears takes `role="alert"` instead.
donts: **Don't** use marigold for facts. The picker's "Best at N" tag is a neutral cube-white tag with a rule outline, and the cube mark's second box is kraft cardboard, not marigold.
**Don't** use marigold for decoration, emphasis, ownership or a primary button.
**Don't** add a saturated colour to the shelf other than the owner edges, and don't add a player colour near marigold's hue.
**Don't** add a box print that is saturated, sits in a player hue, or falls below 4.5:1 with its ink; keep dark prints to about a quarter of the set.
**Don't** download, proxy or re-host BGG box art.

**Don't** put eyebrows or kickers above headings: no small uppercase labels, no label that repeats the tab or title just above it, no group-size label over a game's name. Put that fact in a tag or the line of context.
**Don't** use hard offset shadows. The shadows are Stand and the shelf lift for boxes in cubes and Lift off the shelf, all soft, and on the shelf all from the one light at the upper left.
**Don't** separate cubes with borders or card shadows; the shelf gap does that.
